title: RCVoidedFlatSlab
description: RCVoidedFlatSlab: Floor configuration of a two-way spanning reinforced concrete flat slab containing voids in both directions, supported directly on columns.

Slab.description: Surface property defining the construction and thickness of the slab. BiDirectionalVoided: Property for 2D analytical elements, made up of two slabs with parallel ribs running in two directions between them, all sharing the same material.

SlabReinforcement.description: Reinforcement of the slab, defined either as an estimated density or as an explicit layout. Can be null if no slab reinforcement is to be accounted for. ISlabReinforcement: Base interface for the reinforcement definition of the slab in a floor configuration, for example estimated as a density (EstimateSlabReinforcement) or explicitly laid out (LayoutSlabReinforcement).

VoidMaterial.description: Material in the voided zone of the slab. If null, assumed to be no material in the voided zone (air). Material: Physical material to be used for Takeoffs and asigned to Physical elements. Material is capable of storing discipline specific data in Properties.

_bhomVersion.description: Optional version of BHoM used as part of automatic versioning and schema upgrades.
